title: Premium Homesite Classes and the Home Purchase Agreement Additional Deposit Rate
content:
**Schedule of premium-class uplifts.** The additional deposit rate of a Home Purchase Agreement is uplifted by the premium class of the reserved homesite. The class is that of the buyer's converted Homesite Reservation, and the figure read is the class's lot premium deposit percentage at contract — the percent of the lot premium the Homesite Reservation class requires as the lot premium deposit when the purchase agreement is written.

| Converted Homesite Reservation class: lot premium deposit percentage at contract | Points added to the additional deposit rate |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | 0.6 |
| 25 or more but below 50 | 0.3 |
| Below 25 | Nothing |
| No converted Homesite Reservation | Nothing |

**Rule text.** Where the buyer's converted Homesite Reservation is of a class whose lot premium deposit percentage at contract is 50 or more, 0.6 percentage points are added; where it is 25 or more but below 50, 0.3 percentage points are added; otherwise nothing is added.

**Boundary notes (hypothetical classes).**

- A class at exactly 50 adds 0.6; a class at 49 would add 0.3.
- A class at exactly 25 adds 0.3; a class at 24 would add nothing.
- A class at 100 adds 0.6.
